mechanism: Agents execute transactions immediately without waiting for global consensus, assuming everything is valid. If a conflict is detected later, they use a deterministic rollback rule (e.g., 'highest ID wins'). Maximizes speed over safety. It bypasses the blocking {{quorum}}, executing immediately and using the {{time_warp_log}} to resolve conflicts retroactively.
failure_modes: Applied to irreversible external action (email sent, funds transferred, API called)—rollback impossible, inconsistency permanent.
invariants: Conflict resolution is pure: the same inputs always pick the same winner.
Reverting a transaction cannot corrupt unrelated state.
Applies only to reversible or low-stakes actions.
Conflicts are actively detected, not merely handled if noticed.
preconditions: Target operations are internally reversible (no irreversible external side-effects)
postconditions: Conflict resolution triggered if divergence detected
